svg.title: spell init — arcane-cli 1.23.0
svg.desc: spell init --profile full installs the spell library, governance docs, agent policies and templates into a fresh repository.

text.tspan: Some setup questions were left unanswered. Answer them without a prompt with:
Installed a pre-push hook that warns when the current branch's PR is already closed or merged.
Installed a pre-commit hook that scans staged content for leaked credentials.
Run `spell agents init` to set up your agent team
Review .arcane/governance/ docs and customize for your project
Commit the new files: git add .arcane .github .claude AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md .arcane.json .gitattr
